bad-envelope: Reload the preview and retry the action.
unsupported-protocol: This action uses an unsupported preview protocol.
stale-sequence: Use the current page action sequence.
sequence-gap: The action sequence has a gap.
Use the next expected page action sequence.
conflicting-request: This request conflicts with an admitted action.
Do not reuse a request ID with different content.
busy: Another preview action is in progress.
Wait for the current action to settle.
stale-context: The preview page generation is stale.
stale-generation: Reload the preview after the bot restarts.
stale-revision: The published preview revision is stale.
Read the current page before acting.
validation-failed: The requested action is unavailable for this page.
Check the current authorized control and its values.
query-invalid: Use plain text of at most 128 Unicode code points.
stale-cursor: This result cursor is stale or unavailable.
Start a new query from the current page.
control-unavailable: Use a control in the current authorized page.
context-unavailable: Open a current authorized preview page.
asset-unavailable: Reload the page and check its current authorization.
commands-unsynced: Application commands in the command tree have not been synced to SimCord.
command-unavailable: This command is unavailable in the current page.
Refresh the command catalog and choose a command visible to this viewer.
command-changed: This command schema changed after it was selected.
Refresh the command catalog and review the current options.
command-option-invalid: A command option does not match its declared type or constraints.
Correct the indicated command option and retry.
autocomplete-unanswered: The command did not answer the autocomplete request.
Review the command's autocomplete callback and try again.
access-denied: This page is no longer authorized.
Reopen the preview with an authorized viewer.
action-callback-error: The bot action failed; inspect the local Env error log for details.
Review the underlying exception in Env.errors.
action-timeout: The bot action did not settle before its deadline.
Inspect the page before attempting another action.
action-cancelled: The bot action was cancelled during shutdown.
Inspect the page before attempting another action.
message-type-unknown: This message type is not classified in the preview.
Review the supported message type documentation.
premium-sku-metadata-missing: Premium button presentation metadata is unavailable.
Supply an offline SKU name, price, and locale.
sticker-asset-unavailable: A sticker media asset is unavailable offline.
font-platform-inspection: Use a supported Chromium runtime for font inspection.
internal-error: The preview could not complete this operation.
Inspect the local Env error log for details.
